To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cutting edge preparation and the HIPIMS coatings improve the tool life of micro-milling cutters.
the wear resistance of coated micro-milling tool with cutting edge preparation is significantly improved and that the cutting edge radius rβ influences the active force Fa.
the cutting edge preparation and coating with HIPIMS are effective methods for improving the tool life and wear behaviour of micro-milling inserts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comparison of the wear behaviour of different micro-milling tools in the machining of mould steel X13 NiMnCuAl42-2-1.
the wear behaviour of micro-milling tool with cutting edge preparation.
the improvement of the wear behaviour of micro-milling cutting edges by means of coating technology and cutting edge preparation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HIPIMS coating technology and the cutting edge preparation with immersed tumbling process are suitable for improving the wear behaviour of micro-milling tool for machining steel mould.
the combination of cutting edge preparation and the application of a HIPIMS coating is the optimal solution to improve the micro-milling process.
the cutting edge preparation using immersion tumbling process and the application of AlTiN coatings with HIPIMS technology lead to the longest possible tool life.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cutting edge preparation using the immersed tumbling process and a coating using the HIPIMS-technology are a promising approach for micro-milling of mould steels.
the cutting edge preparation and the AlTiN coating are suitable for improving the tool wear behaviour and the path length of micro-milling.
the cutting edge preparation and the HIPIMS coating are effective measures to increase tool life in micro-milling of mould steels.

the cutting edge preparation and coating with AlTiN can be used to increase the path length lc by a factor of 2.
the combination of cutting edge preparation and coating technology with HIPIMS is a very effective way to improve the tool wear behaviour of micro-milling tool.
the cutting edge preparation with the immersed tumbling process is a suitable method to increase tool lifetime.
